title: Add Ollama and local HTTP model adapter support

context.summary: Implement the supported local HTTP model adapter path in @mindory/llm and add provider health checks for local model services.
context.background: TASK-73 made OpenAI-compatible chat and embeddings real. The next public-ready gap is allowing supported chat and text-embedding roles to use a local HTTP model service, while keeping Ollama text embeddings health-checkable and centrally configured.

in: Add local HTTP chat and text embedding adapters inside @mindory/llm.
Keep Ollama text embeddings routed through @mindory/llm and add provider health check coverage.
Expose provider health checks from the @mindory/llm runtime.
Promote local-http support for supported chat and text-embedding roles in the config catalog.
Validate local HTTP adapter behavior with fake HTTP responses.
Update installer validation expectations and LLM/config/status docs.
out: Implementing OCR, ASR, vision, face, image-generation or audio-generation adapters.
Adding external model servers or downloading local model weights.
Persisting model health or operation audit records to the database.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/llm can build a local-http chat provider when chat is enabled.
@mindory/llm can build a local-http text embedding provider when text embeddings are enabled.
Local HTTP chat calls /chat/completions and local HTTP embeddings call /embeddings.
The runtime exposes health checks for Ollama and local-http providers.
Config and installer validation treat local-http as supported for chat and text-embedding roles.
Docs describe local HTTP endpoint contracts and health checks.

manual_checks: Confirm no product flow requires local HTTP models by default.

risks: Local HTTP should not be claimed for unsupported multimodal roles before concrete adapters exist.
Health checks must not require model calls or secrets.
Changing provider support levels must not enable model roles by default.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
